text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The dream stage to decide Japan's best: 
the Japanese Derby. Its intense pressure 
weighs heavily upon her shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even so, she had to stand and face it. To 
be recognized as worthy of shouldering 
people's hopes, as someone with the 
caliber to aim for the top of the world.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Watching from the stands, Mei Satake 
understood that resolve. —The Japan Derby 
begins.
